answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks with harvest-gated stake: every identity must lock a quartz-crystal staking bond that only unlocks after a growing orchard of real work transactions. A falcon monitors the ledger, flagging identities whose behavior clusters too tightly to be independent. Creating fake identities is expensive because each one must post collateral and wait through the growth period, so mass-producing identities costs more than the attack can gain.
